summary: Distinguish optional Ord dependency waits from unavailable console observations
details: Release console views use the same expiring host observation for the optional Ord backend. The overview removes its contradictory HTTP-only Ord card; service selectors and headings show dependency waits, indexing, failures or unknown state instead of labeling every unopened HTTP endpoint offline.

Missing host observations remain visible even before the first snapshot. Guidance distinguishes a running supervisor waiting for txindex from an active Ord indexer, and preserves the boundary between optional backend readiness and ordinary node readiness.

console start warns when the independent host observer is not installed. It still starts only the private console and installed observer; it does not automatically install system services or restart Bitcoin.
operator_actions: Upgrade the node kit and services image together. On older nodes lacking the observer, run usdb-node controller install followed by usdb-node console start as the node operator; installation may require sudo. Foreground deployments can keep usdb-node console monitor running instead.
